hypersim_candidates: two raw normal_cam frames flagged by entire-frame length >2; identities kept in private audit
depth_source: official versioned Hypersim ZIP member depth_meters; Euclidean distance, not camera-z

depth_comparison.orientation: fixed camera-facing native GL depth normal, compare signed angle to unit raw normal_cam; no per-frame sign selection
depth_comparison.failure_action: exclude direction-inconsistent candidate from derived train/val record lists; unresolved/missing source keeps long training held

gso_main_gt: barycentrically interpolated area-weighted vertex geometry normals, unit-normalized at hit; no material, bump, normalTexture or custom split normals
gso_secondary_gt: ray-hit face geometry normal at identical pixels
gso_disagreement: signed angular difference of the two GTs on their identical ray-hit mask, report per-image, per-asset macro and pixel-pooled; a GT-definition gap, not an irreducible model-error lower bound
gso_scores: main MAE against smooth geometry plus secondary face MAE and GT-definition angular gap; no model scoring during preparation
dino_padding: symmetric replicate, 5 pixels on each side for 256->266, pixel centers shifted by left/top offset in feature registration
